repo_notes.content: Use current source and configuration as authority. Historical docs/probes and accuracy experiments are not proof of current production state. Cover every workspace within the pages below and explain cross-package relationships. Do not publish secret values. Preserve strict coverage rules from AGENTS.md.

pages.title: Architecture and developer setup
pages.purpose: Map every apps/* and packages/* workspace, runtime, dependency, data flow, package instruction, and verification command.

pages.title: Data ingestion and freshness
pages.purpose: Document sync-realtime-data, sync-realtime-data-hot, sync-realtime-data-features, daily-keiba-sync, local-postgresql, and race-time freshness guarantees.

pages.title: Storage and catalog
pages.purpose: Document horse-racing-data-lake, horse-racing-duckdb, pc-keiba-r2-catalog, schemas, R2 access, migrations and read paths.

pages.title: Viewer and APIs
pages.purpose: Document pc-keiba-viewer UI, APIs, SSR caches, authentication and data sources.

pages.title: Prediction orchestration
pages.purpose: Document finish-position-cron and finish-position-predict-container queues, Durable Objects, model loading, retries, concurrency and deployment safety.

pages.title: Features and model evaluation
pages.purpose: Document viewer Python feature engineering, training, temporal splits, leakage controls, model promotion, historical experiments and current production provenance.

pages.title: Time series and weather
pages.purpose: Document timesfm-finish-position and venue-weather, platform requirements, feature timestamps and model consumers.

pages.title: MLflow and observability
pages.purpose: Document mlflow, mlflow-ui, mlflow-ui-proxy and pipeline-health-monitor monitoring, artifacts and incident diagnosis.

pages.title: Desktop and external sources
pages.purpose: Document JRA-VAN apps, umacon-worker, save-oversea-keiba-records and scripts desktop automation, separating Linux, macOS and Windows capabilities.

pages.title: Shared libraries and agent tools
pages.purpose: Document every packages/* library, the viewer MCP plugin, authentication and client integration.

pages.title: Testing and operations
pages.purpose: Document lefthook, package coverage gates, GitHub Actions, deployment scripts, secrets requirements and operational runbooks.
